senses.definition: To move something such as a door, window, book, or container so that it is no longer shut.
To undo a knot, tie, button, or fastened thing.

examples.text: उसने अपने जूते के फ़ीते खोल दिए।

senses.definition: To start or set up a shop, business, or bank account.

examples.text: उन्होंने बैंक में नया खाता खोला।
examples.translation: They opened a new account at the bank.
